source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 9 exercise solved (PDF 216-217), MCQ keys worked out from the chapter, model answers for every question.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Human Digestive System) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Where does chemical digestion of carbohydrates begin?
(Carbohydrates ka chemical digestion kahan se shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Munh mein saliva ka salivary amylase starch aur glycogen ko maltose mein torta hai, is liye carbohydrates ka digestion munh se shuru hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Which enzyme in saliva starts breaking down starch?
(Saliva ka kaun sa enzyme starch torna shuru karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Saliva mein salivary amylase (ptyalin) hota hai jo starch aur glycogen ko maltose mein torta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. What prevents food from entering the trachea during swallowing?
(Nigalte waqt khana trachea (saans ki nali) mein jane se kaun rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nigalte waqt larynx upar uthta aur epiglottis (cartilage ka dhakkan) neeche aa kar trachea ka munh band kar deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Why does the enzyme activity drops in the stomach when pH rises?
(Maide mein pH barhne par enzymes ka kaam kyun kam ho jata hai?)

options.text: Tezab khane ka dakhla rokta hai
Kam pH par enzymes kharab (denature) hote hain
Enzymes ko kaam ke liye tezabi (acidic) pH chahiye
Saliva gastric juice ko patla karta hai

blocks.explanation: HCl maide ka pH taqreeban 2-3 rakhta aur pepsinogen ko pepsin banata hai; maide ke enzymes tezabi pH mein kaam karte hain, is liye pH barhne par un ka kaam kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Which change would most affect protein digestion?
(Kaun si tabdeeli protein digestion par sab se zyada asar karegi?)
blocks.explanation: Pepsin maide mein protein digestion shuru karta hai (proteins se polypeptides); bile fats par aur saliva starch par kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Why is lipase not active in the stomach?
(Lipase maide mein faal (active) kyun nahi hota?)

options.text: Tezab use khatam kar deta hai
Use kaam ke liye alkaline pH chahiye
Yeh sirf proteins hazam karta hai

blocks.explanation: Pancreatic lipase duodenum mein kaam karta hai jahan pancreatic juice (pH 8, bicarbonate) mahaul alkaline banata hai; maida tezabi (pH 2-3) hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Which stomach secretion activates pepsin and kills bacteria?
(Maide ki kaun si ratoobat (secretion) pepsin ko faal karti aur bacteria marti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Parietal cells ka HCl pepsinogen ko pepsin banata aur jaraseem (microorganisms) marta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Why is segmentation important in the small intestine?
(Small intestine mein segmentation kyun ahem hai?)

options.text: Yeh khane ko digestive juices se milati hai
Yeh khana rectum ki taraf dhakelti hai

blocks.explanation: Segmentation ek hi jagah aage peeche ki harkat hai jo khane ko digestive ratoobaton se milati aur absorption barhati hai; aage dhakelna peristalsis ka kaam hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. What is the function of villi and microvilli in the small intestine?
(Small intestine mein villi aur microvilli ka kaam kya hai?)

options.text: Absorption ke liye surface area barhana

blocks.explanation: Villi aur un ke cells ke microvilli absorption ka kul surface area bohat zyada barha dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
10. Which best explains the liver's role in digestion?
(Digestion mein liver ka kirdar sab se behtar kaun sa jawab batata hai?)

options.text: Yeh ghair-hazam khana zakheera karta hai
Yeh fat digestion ke liye bile banata hai
Yeh colon mein enzymes dalta hai

blocks.explanation: Liver bile banata hai jo fats ko emulsify kar ke digestion aasan karta hai; insulin pancreas banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. What is the main function of the digestive system?
Digestive system ka bunyadi kaam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Digestive system khane ko chhote, jazb hone wale hisson mein torta (digestion) aur unhein blood aur lymph mein jazb karta hai. Is se jism ko tawanai aur growth, marammat aur dekh bhaal ka saman milta hai; bacha hua fuzla bahar nikal diya jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. What is the mode of action of saliva in mouth?
Munh mein saliva kaise kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Saliva ka pani aur mucus khane ko geela aur chikna karte hain; bicarbonate ions buffer karte aur thiocyanate ions jaraseem marte hain. Salivary amylase starch aur glycogen ko maltose mein torta hai. Chaba hua khana chhota geela gola (bolus) ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. What is role of tongue in the mouth?
Munh mein zabaan ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Zabaan taste buds se chakh kar khana chunti hai (bura zaiqa ya sakht cheez rad). Yeh chabaye khane ko saliva se milati aur nigalte waqt upar aur peeche ja kar bolus ko munh ke pichle hisse mein dhakelti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. What role does the epiglottis play during swallowing?
Nigalte waqt epiglottis kya kirdar ada karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Nigalte waqt larynx upar uthta aur epiglottis (cartilage ka dhakkan) neeche aa kar trachea ka munh (glottis) band kar deta hai. Is tarah bolus saans ki nali ke upar se guzar kar oesophagus mein jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. What is the composition of gastric juice?
Gastric juice mein kya kuch hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
Gastric juice gastric glands ki ratoobat hai:
- Mucus (mucous cells): maide ki andar ki teh bachata hai.
- Hydrochloric acid (parietal cells): pH 2-3.
- Pepsinogen (chief cells): pepsin banta hai.
(Bachon mein rennin bhi hota hai.)

blocks.prompt:
6. Why is hydrochloric acid (HCl) important in the stomach?
Maide mein hydrochloric acid (HCl) kyun ahem hai?
blocks.explanation: HCl maide ka pH taqreeban 2-3 rakhta, khana naram karta, pepsinogen ko pepsin banata (protein digestion ke liye) aur khane ke saath aaye jaraseem marta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. What is the difference between bolus and chyme?
Bolus aur chyme mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono digestion ke dauran khane ki shaklein hain: bolus munh mein, chyme maide mein banta hai.

rows: Munh mein banta hai
Maide mein banta hai
Saliva mila chaba hua chhota geela gola
Gastric juice mila neem-maya (semi-liquid) tezabi madda
Halka alkaline/neutral (saliva)
Tezabi (HCl)
Pharynx aur oesophagus se maide mein jata hai
Pyloric sphincter se small intestine mein jata hai

blocks.prompt:
8. Which organ produces bile, and what is its function?
Bile kaun sa organ banata hai aur us ka kaam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Bile liver banata hai aur gallbladder us ko zakheera karta hai. Is ke bile salts fats ko emulsify karte (chhote qatron mein torte) hain taake lipase ko kaam ke liye bara surface area mile.

blocks.prompt:
9. Differentiate between physical and chemical digestion.
Physical aur chemical digestion mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono khana torte hain, magar physical digestion sirf size chhota karta hai jab ke chemical digestion molecules badal deta hai.

rows: Khana mechanical tor par chhote tukron mein
Bare molecules chhote molecules mein
Enzymes nahi; daant, muscles aur bile se
Enzymes (aur HCl) se
Khane ki kimiyai (chemical) shakal nahi badalti
Nai aur saada cheezein banti hain
Misal: chabana, maide mein churning, emulsification
Misal: amylase starch se maltose; pepsin proteins se polypeptides

blocks.prompt:
10. What do you understand by emulsification of fats?
Fats ki emulsification se aap kya samajhte hain?
blocks.explanation: Fats pani mein hal nahi hote, is liye lipase un par aasani se kaam nahi karta. Bile salts detergent ki tarah fats ko chhote qatron (emulsion) mein tor kar alag rakhte hain; is se lipase ko bara surface area milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
11. What is role of the role of the pyloric sphincter in digestion?
Digestion mein pyloric sphincter ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Pyloric sphincter maide ke aakhir mein muscle ka chhalla hai. Yeh chyme ko thora thora maide se small intestine (duodenum) mein jane deta hai, taake khana maide mein hazam hone tak ruka rahe.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "role of the" do dafa chhapa hai; sahi sawal: "What is the role of the pyloric sphincter in digestion?"

blocks.prompt:
12. How do villi and microvilli help in nutrient absorption?
Villi aur microvilli ghiza ke jazb hone (absorption) mein kaise madad karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Villi jejunum aur ileum ki tahon par ungli jaise ubhaar hain; in ke cells par microvilli hote hain. Dono mil kar jazb karne ki surface bohat bari kar dete hain. Har villus mein blood capillaries (sugars, amino acids) aur lacteal (fats, chylomicrons ki shakal mein) hote hain jin par sirf ek cell moti teh hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
13. What are the main functions of the large intestine?
Large intestine ke bunyadi kaam kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Pani, namkiyat (salts) aur vitamin K ko blood mein jazb karti hai (zyada tar colon).
2. Pani nikalne se faeces (fuzla) banta hai; is ke bacteria (maslan E. coli) vitamin K aur amino acids banate hain.
3. Rectum faeces ko waqti tor par rakhta aur anus se bahar nikalta hai (egestion).

blocks.prompt:
14. What causes jaundice in the digestive system?
Digestive system mein jaundice (yarqan) ki wajah kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Bile mein bile pigments hote hain. Agar yeh digestive tract se nikal na sakein (maslan gall stones bile duct band kar dein) to blood mein jama ho kar jaundice (jild aur aankhon ka peela pan) karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
15. How does stress negatively impact digestion?
Stress (dabao) digestion par bura asar kaise dalta hai?
blocks.explanation: (Beyond the chapter.) Stress mein sympathetic nervous system aur stress hormones khoon ko maide/aant se hata dete hain aur digestive juices aur peristalsis kam kar dete hain, is liye digestion sust (bad-hazmi, qabz). Stress tezab bhi barha sakta hai jis se heartburn aur ulcer ho sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain the complete process of digestion, starting from ingestion in the mouth to egestion in the large intestine. Include the roles of mechanical and chemical digestion at each stage.
Munh mein khana lene (ingestion) se le kar large intestine se fuzla nikalne (egestion) tak digestion ka poora amal bayan karein; har marhale par mechanical aur chemical digestion ka kirdar shamil karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Munh (oral cavity):
- Khana lena aur chunna: honth khana rokte; zabaan ke taste buds, soonghna aur dekhna khana chunte hain.
- Mechanical: daant chaba kar (mastication) khane ke chhote tukre karte, surface area barhta hai; zabaan, taalu aur gaal saliva se milate hain.
- Chemical: teen jori glands (sublingual, submaxillary, parotid) ka saliva: pani aur mucus geela karte, bicarbonate buffer, thiocyanate jaraseem maarta, salivary amylase starch/glycogen ko maltose banata hai. Khana bolus ban jata hai.
2. Pharynx aur nigalna: zabaan bolus ko peeche dhakelti; soft palate naak ka rasta band karta; larynx upar aur epiglottis trachea band karta; bolus oesophagus mein jata hai.
3. Oesophagus (taqreeban 25 cm): peristalsis bolus ko neeche le jata (mechanical); saliva ka amal jari rehta. Cardiac sphincter khana maide mein jane deta aur wapsi rokta hai.
4. Maida (stomach):
- Mechanical: teen muscle tahein (longitudinal, circular, oblique) khane ko mathti (churning) aur gastric juice se milati hain; garmi se solid fats pighalte hain.
- Chemical: HCl (pH 2-3) jaraseem maarta aur pepsinogen ko pepsin banata; pepsin proteins ko polypeptides/peptides mein torta; mucus deewar bachata; bachon mein rennin doodh jamata hai. 3-4 ghante baad khana tezabi chyme ban kar pyloric sphincter se aage jata hai.
5. Small intestine (6 m):
- Mechanical: peristalsis aage le jata, segmentation juices se milati, bile salts fats emulsify karte hain.
- Duodenum mein chemical: pancreatic juice (pH 8) chyme ka tezab khatam karta; pancreatic amylase (starch se maltose), trypsin (enterokinase trypsinogen ko trypsin banata), chymotrypsin aur carboxypeptidase (peptides aur amino acids), lipase (fatty acids aur glycerol), nucleases (DNA/RNA se nucleotides).
- Jejunum aur ileum mein chemical: intestinal juice: aminopeptidase, erypsin (amino acids), lipase, maltase, sucrase, lactase (glucose, fructose, galactose). Chyme alkaline chyle ban jata hai.
- Absorption: villi aur microvilli sugars aur amino acids ko blood capillaries (hepatic portal vein se liver) aur fats ko chylomicrons bana kar lacteals mein jazb karte hain.
6. Large intestine (taqreeban 1 m): caecum (appendix ke saath), colon, rectum. Colon pani, salts aur vitamin K (E. coli jaise bacteria banate hain) jazb karta; baqi faeces banta hai (bacteria, cellulose, ghair-hazam khana, murda cells, bile pigments, pani).
7. Egestion: faeces rectum mein jama hote; bharne par defecation reflex anus se bahar nikalta hai. Bachon mein yeh reflex ghair-iradi (spinal cord), baron mein cerebral cortex external anal sphincter ko iradi tor par control karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the structure and function of the stomach in digestion.
Digestion mein maide (stomach) ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Banawat:
- Oesophagus ke baad aur duodenum se pehle J-shakal ka lachakdar muscular thaila; pet ke baayein (left) taraf diaphragm ke neeche.
- Teen hisse: cardiac (oesophagus ke foran baad), fundus (cardiac ke ek taraf), pyloric (cardiac ke neeche). Dakhle par cardiac sphincter, nikalne par pyloric sphincter.
- Deewar: bahar serosa; phir muscles ki teen tahein: bahar longitudinal, beech circular, andar oblique; phir submucosa aur mucosa.
- Mucosa mein bohat se tubular gastric glands jo gastric pits se khulte hain. Har gland mein epithelial cells aur teen secretory cells: mucous cells, parietal (oxyntic) cells, chief cells.
Kaam:
1. Zakheera: cardiac sphincter khulne par khana aata aur 3-4 ghante rukta hai.
2. Mechanical digestion: teen muscle tahein zor se sikur kar khana mathti (churning) aur gastric juice se milati hain; garmi se solid fats pighalte hain.
3. Chemical digestion:
- Mucous cells ka mucus (bicarbonate ke saath) mucosa ko HCl aur pepsin se bachata hai.
- Parietal cells ka HCl: pH 2-3, khana naram, pepsinogen faal, jaraseem khatam.
- Chief cells ka pepsinogen; HCl ka H⁺ use pepsin banata jo proteins ko polypeptides aur peptides mein torta hai.
- Bachon mein rennin doodh ke proteins jamata hai.
4. Khana chyme (neem-maya tezabi madda) ban jata aur pyloric sphincter use ahista ahista small intestine mein bhejta hai.
5. Ratoobat ko nerves (khane ko dekhna, soonghna, sochna; maide ka phailna) aur gastrin hormone control karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Compare and contrast the roles of the small intestine and large intestine in digestion.
Digestion mein small intestine aur large intestine ke kirdar ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Dono maide ke baad aant ke hisse hain aur dono absorption karte hain (chhoti aant: hazam shuda khana; bari aant: pani aur salts). Small intestine digestion mukammal kar ke khana jazb karti hai; large intestine pani jazb kar ke faeces banati aur nikalti hai.

rows: Sab se lamba hissa: taqreeban 6 m lamba, 2-3 cm chaura
Chhota: aant ka aakhri taqreeban 1 m
Hisse: duodenum, jejunum, ileum
Hisse: caecum (appendix ke saath), colon, rectum
Pancreatic juice, bile aur intestinal juice se har khane ka aakhri digestion
Digestive enzymes nahi; digestion na hone ke barabar
Hazam shuda khana (sugars, amino acids, fats) aur pani jazb
Pani, salts aur vitamin K jazb
Andar tahein, villi aur microvilli
Tahdar nahi; villi nahi
Chyme se chyle banta hai
Bacha hua faeces banta hai
Segmentation milati, peristalsis aage le jata hai
Rectum faeces rakhta; defecation reflex nikalta hai
Bacteria kam
Bohat bacteria (maslan E. coli) vitamin K aur amino acids banate hain

blocks.prompt:
4. Explain the absorption of food from the small intestine?
Small intestine se khane ka absorption bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Jagah: hazam shuda khana, pani aur ghule minerals jejunum aur ileum mein jazb hote hain.
Banawat ki khoobiyan: andar ki deewar par bari gol tahein, un par ungli jaise villi; villi ke cells par anginat microvilli, is liye surface area bohat bara (andar se makhmal jaisi). Har villus mein blood capillaries aur lymph ki nali lacteal hoti hai, jin par ek cell moti teh hoti hai.
1. Saada sugars aur amino acids:
- Diffusion ya active transport se villi ke cells mein, phir blood capillaries mein.
- Capillaries mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain jo inhein liver le jati hai.
- Liver zaid glucose ko glycogen aur amino acids ko proteins bana kar rakhta; zaroorat ke mutabiq hepatic vein se dil ko bhejta hai.
2. Fatty acids aur glycerol:
- Passive transport se epithelial cells mein, jahan dobara triglycerides bante hain.
- Triglycerides par protein ki teh chadh kar chylomicrons (chhote qatre) bante hain jo lacteals mein jate hain.
- Lacteals se thoracic lymphatic duct aur phir blood mein.
- Plasma ke enzymes chylomicrons ko fats aur proteins mein, aur fats ko aakhir fatty acids aur glycerol mein tor dete hain jo cells mein jate hain.
3. Pani aur minerals bhi saath jazb hote hain; baqi pani aur salts large intestine mein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: sugars aur amino acids → blood capillaries → hepatic portal vein → liver. Fats → chylomicrons → lacteal → thoracic duct → blood.

blocks.prompt:
5. Discuss accessory organs (liver, gallbladder and pancreas) and their contributions in digestion.
Accessory organs (liver, gallbladder aur pancreas) aur digestion mein un ka hissa bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Accessory organs GI tract ka hissa nahi magar apni ratoobatein us mein dalte hain (salivary glands ke saath).
1. Liver:
- Bile banata hai; bile salts fats ko chhote qatron mein emulsify kar ke lipase ke liye bara surface dete hain. Bile pigments bahar nikalte hain; rasta band ho to jaundice.
- Small intestine se aaye nutrients (hepatic portal vein se) sambhalta: glucose ko glycogen bana kar rakhta (zaroorat par wapas), vitamins A, D, B12, K, iron, copper aur fats zakheera karta hai.
- Metabolic kaam: fats tor kar tawanai, cholesterol aur lipoproteins banana, amino acids badalna aur zehreeli ammonia ko urea banana, zeher, dawaiyan aur alcohol khatam karna, proteins banana, hormones torna.
2. Gallbladder:
- Liver ka bile zakheera aur gaarha karta hai.
- Khana (fats, adhe hazam proteins) small intestine mein aaye to common bile duct se bile duodenum mein chhorta hai.
- Cholesterol jam kar gall stones bana sakta hai jo bile rok dete hain.
3. Pancreas: maide ke neeche (ventral) bara gland, do hisse:
- Exocrine (nali wala): pancreatic juice pancreatic duct mein, jo common bile duct se mil kar duodenum mein khulti hai. Juice (pH 8, bicarbonate) tezabi chyme ko neutralize karta aur har khane ke enzymes rakhta hai: amylase (starch se maltose), trypsin, chymotrypsin, carboxypeptidase (proteins se amino acids), lipase (fats se fatty acids aur glycerol), nucleases (nucleic acids se nucleotides).
- Endocrine (bina nali): insulin aur glucagon blood mein.
Control: secretin (tezabi chyme duodenum mein aane par) aur cholecystokinin, CCK (adhe hazam proteins aur fats se) pancreas se juice aur gallbladder se bile nikalwate hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe the hormonal and nervous regulation of gastric acid secretion.
Gastric acid ki ratoobat ka hormonal aur nervous control bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Gastric juice (HCl samait) ki ratoobat nervous system aur hormones dono control karte hain.
A. Nervous control:
1. Khane ki khushboo, shakal ya khayal se dimagh ka medulla gastric glands ko paigham (nerve impulses) bhejta hai aur khana aane se pehle hi thora gastric juice nikalta hai.
2. Khana aane par maide ka phailna (distension) aur pH ka girna mazeed ratoobat aur tez contractions karata hai.
B. Hormonal control:
1. Gastrin: khane ke proteins maide ki mucosa ke endocrine cells se gastrin nikalwate hain; blood use gastric glands tak le jata hai jo zyada gastric juice (HCl, pepsinogen) banate hain.
2. Somatostatin: jab khana maide se small intestine mein jata hai to somatostatin hormone HCl ka nikalna rok deta hai.
C. Aant ke hormones: duodenum mein tezabi chyme secretin aur adhe hazam proteins/fats CCK nikalwate hain; dono pancreas aur gallbladder ko uksate hain jin ka alkaline juice aur bile tezab ko neutralize karte hain.
Yun nerves ratoobat shuru karte, gastrin khana maide mein hone tak barhata, aur somatostatin maida khaali hone par rok deta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tarteeb yaad rakhein: soch/khushboo → medulla → thora juice; khana aaya → phailao + proteins → gastrin → zyada juice; khana aage gaya → somatostatin → HCl band.

blocks.prompt:
1. Why does the small intestine need both peristalsis and segmentation?
Small intestine ko peristalsis aur segmentation dono ki zaroorat kyun hai?
blocks.explanation:
Dono harkatein alag kaam karti hain:
- Peristalsis sikurne ki lehar hai jo khana aant mein aage dhakelti hai.
- Segmentation ek hi jagah aage peeche ki harkat hai jo khane ko pancreatic juice, bile aur intestinal juice se milati aur villi se milwati hai, is se digestion aur absorption barhta hai.
Segmentation na ho to khana poora hazam aur jazb hue baghair guzar jaye; peristalsis na ho to khana large intestine tak na jaye. Is liye dono zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. How does the liver help digestion without using enzymes?
Liver enzymes istemal kiye baghair digestion mein kaise madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Liver bile banata hai jis mein digestive enzymes nahi hote. Bile salts detergent ki tarah fats ko chhote qatron mein emulsify kar ke alag rakhte hain, is se pancreatic lipase ko bara surface milta hai. Bile alkaline hai aur tezabi chyme ko neutralize karne mein madad deta hai (beyond the chapter: chapter is ke liye pancreatic juice ka bicarbonate batata hai). Liver jazb shuda ghiza (glycogen, vitamins, minerals, fats) ko sambhalta, zakheera aur taqseem bhi karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Why do we need bile if we already have enzymes for fat digestion?
Jab fats hazam karne ke enzymes maujood hain to bile ki zaroorat kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Fats pani mein hal nahi hote aur bare qatre bana lete hain, is liye pani mein ghulne wala lipase sirf un ki bahar ki thori si surface par kaam kar sakta hai. Bile salts fats ko nanhe qatron mein emulsify kar ke alag rakhte hain, is se lipase ke kaam ki surface bohat barh jati hai aur fat jaldi aur poora hazam hota hai. Bile khud fat hazam nahi karta; enzyme ko asardar banata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: bara makhan ka tukra pani mein der se ghulta hai, magar chhote chhote tukre jaldi. Bile fat ko chhote tukron mein tor deta hai taake lipase har tukre par ek saath kaam kare.

blocks.prompt:
4. How does the pancreas “know” when to release its enzymes?
Pancreas ko kaise "pata" chalta hai ke enzymes kab chhorne hain?
blocks.explanation:
Duodenum ke hormones use batate hain:
1. Tezabi chyme duodenum mein aaye to us ka tezab duodenum ki deewar se secretin blood mein nikalwata hai.
2. Chyme ke adhe hazam proteins aur fats deewar se cholecystokinin (CCK) nikalwate hain.
3. Blood yeh hormones pancreas tak le jata hai jo pancreatic juice chhorta hai (aur gallbladder bile).
Yun pancreas tabhi enzymes chhorta hai jab khana waqai small intestine tak pohanch jaye.

blocks.prompt:
5. Why are pancreatic secretions alkaline, not acidic?
Pancreatic ratoobatein tezabi ki bajaye alkaline kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Maide se aane wala chyme sakht tezabi (pH 2-3) hota hai; pancreatic juice (pH 8) ka bicarbonate use neutralize karta hai.
2. Pancreatic enzymes (amylase, trypsin, lipase waghaira) alkaline mahaul mein kaam karte hain; maslan lipase tezabi maide mein kaam nahi karta, use alkaline pH chahiye.
3. Tezab khatam hone se duodenum ki andar ki teh bachti hai jis par maide jaisi mucus ki moti hifazat nahi, aur pepsin ka amal ruk jata hai (beyond the chapter).
